text: MEXICO PLANS 2,377 KM OF NEW RAIL — CALDERON BUILT 65. The numbers: Calderon 65 km in 6 years. Pena Nieto 187 km. AMLO delivered 1,736 km. Now Sheinbaum plans 2,377 km more. 88,559 tons of rail under contract, military engineers completed 800 km of route planning.

TRUMP SIGNS ORDER TO CUT MIGRANTS OFF FROM US BANKS — New executive order targets bank accounts, credit cards, mortgages, and auto loans for anyone classified as inadmissible or removable. Treasury has 60 days to issue formal alerts to all financial institutions.

GARCIA LUNAS BUSINESS PARTNERS ORDERED TO PAY $578.5 MILLION TO MEXICO — A Florida court condemned the Weinberg family to pay $578.5 million in damages for corrupt public security contracts under Calderon. Total damages against Garcia Luna and associates now exceed $3.067 billion.

TORTILLA PRICES STABLE THROUGH END OF 2026 — The Consejo Nacional de la Tortilla confirms no further price increases expected through year-end. Average national price at 24.27 pesos/kg, up just 37 centavos since January. Corn prices below historical levels.

MOSCOW AND BEIJING REJECT WORLD ORDER "WHERE ONLY FORCE PREVAILS" — Days after Trump left Beijing, Putin arrived and he and Xi signed 42 cooperation agreements, extended their 25-year friendship treaty, and issued a joint rejection of a return to a world order where only force prevails.
